## Novelty pre-check

Verdict: **likely_resolved**. The generating function identifies the sum as θ₃(e^(−π)). R14 studies the Taylor expansion at exactly this point. Its constant term is the classical value Γ(1/4)/(√2·π^(3/4)), which equals π^(1/4)/Γ(3/4) by Euler’s reflection formula. The abstract omits the explicit constant, but that omission is not evidence of openness.
